text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is a special race whose participants are chosen by fans in a vote.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond was second place in the vote, and Kitasan Black was first.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black's definitely gonna win today! The way she perseveres right until the end is unmatched!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: And when she hits that extra gear! No average burst of speed can vie with that!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Kitasan's our shining star of hope! I hope she does her very best!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Everyone was talking about Kita.
choice_data_list: You came in a close second, though!
You came in a close second, though!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You're too kind, Trainer… I wouldn't exactly call 20,000 votes behind close.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: But I'm still thrilled that so many people voted for me. It's truly an honor. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I just get the impression that all of Kita's fans support her so passionately.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: They're not just cheering for her. They really care about her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hm… I would be lying if I said I wasn't…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: But the grass is always greener on the other side of the fence, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And thinking about all the disappointment I'm about to put Kita's fans through gives me a bit of a guilty conscience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond lets out a mischievous laugh. She's already declaring her victory. This is very promising.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's almost time. I'll be going now!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The runner bearing the name of a precious jewel makes her dazzling entrance. Second place in the fan vote, it's Satono Diamond!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And last but not least, it's the winner of the fan vote, Kitasan Black!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: WOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …I'm finally here, Kita!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for this moment, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the wait. Now, I'm going to prove to you that I've truly caught up to you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No… I'm going to completely surpass you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm not gonna let that happen! Let's do this, Dia!
